name: Bomb
text: Drawing this knocks you out, unless you have a Defuse.

name: Defuse
text: When you draw a Bomb, discard this and slip the Bomb back into the deck.

name: Peek
text: Look at the top three cards of the deck.

name: Steal
text: The next player gives you a card of their choice.

name: Nope
text: Play when someone else plays a card: it does nothing. A Nope can be Noped.
